reviewed_statement: Law 7.1 establishes the standard scheduled 90 regulation minutes (2 x 45), excluding interval, extra time and shoot-outs. Reduction requires prior referee/team agreement and competition-rule permission. Added time and penalty completion can extend play; abandonment can prevent completion.
